changelog.en: Installed add-ons now reliably appear on the Enhanced Features tab after the restart. Add-ons that were installed but did not show up are visible again.
changelog.de: Installierte Add-ons erscheinen nach dem Neustart jetzt zuverlässig im Register „Erweiterte Funktionen“. Add-ons, die installiert, aber nicht zu sehen waren, sind wieder sichtbar.
changelog.fr: Les modules installés apparaissent désormais de manière fiable dans le ruban après le redémarrage. Les modules installés mais invisibles s'affichent à nouveau.
changelog.it: I componenti aggiuntivi installati ora compaiono in modo affidabile nella barra multifunzione dopo il riavvio. Quelli installati ma non visibili sono di nuovo visibili.
changelog.es: Los complementos instalados ahora aparecen de forma fiable en la cinta de opciones tras reiniciar. Los complementos instalados que no se veían vuelven a estar visibles.
changelog.nl: Geïnstalleerde add-ons verschijnen na het opnieuw starten nu betrouwbaar op het lint. Add-ons die geïnstalleerd waren maar niet zichtbaar, zijn weer te zien.
changelog.pt: Os suplementos instalados aparecem agora de forma fiável no friso após reiniciar. Os suplementos instalados que não eram visíveis voltam a aparecer.
changelog.da: Installerede tilføjelsesprogrammer vises nu pålideligt på båndet efter genstart. Tilføjelsesprogrammer, der var installeret men ikke synlige, vises igen.
changelog.fi: Asennetut lisäosat näkyvät nyt luotettavasti valintanauhassa uudelleenkäynnistyksen jälkeen. Asennetut mutta näkymättömät lisäosat näkyvät taas.
changelog.nb: Installerte tillegg vises nå pålitelig på båndet etter omstart. Tillegg som var installert, men ikke synlige, vises igjen.
changelog.sv: Installerade tillägg visas nu tillförlitligt i menyfliksområdet efter omstart. Tillägg som var installerade men inte syntes visas igen.
changelog.pl: Zainstalowane dodatki po ponownym uruchomieniu niezawodnie pojawiają się teraz na wstążce. Dodatki, które były zainstalowane, ale niewidoczne, znów są widoczne.
changelog.cs: Nainstalované doplňky se nyní po restartu spolehlivě zobrazí na pásu karet. Doplňky, které byly nainstalované, ale nebyly vidět, se opět zobrazují.
changelog.hu: A telepített bővítmények újraindítás után most már megbízhatóan megjelennek a menüszalagon. A telepített, de nem látható bővítmények ismét láthatók.
changelog.ru: Установленные надстройки теперь надежно появляются на ленте после перезапуска. Надстройки, которые были установлены, но не отображались, снова видны.
changelog.tr: Yüklenen eklentiler artık yeniden başlatmadan sonra şeritte güvenilir şekilde görünür. Yüklü olup görünmeyen eklentiler yeniden görünür.
changelog.zh-Hans: 重新启动后，已安装的加载项现在会可靠地显示在功能区中。已安装但未显示的加载项会重新显示。
changelog.zh-Hant: 重新啟動後，已安裝的增益集現在會可靠地顯示在功能區中。已安裝但未顯示的增益集會重新顯示。
changelog.ja: 再起動後、インストールしたアドオンがリボンに確実に表示されるようになりました。インストール済みなのに表示されなかったアドオンも再び表示されます。
changelog.ko: 다시 시작한 후 설치한 추가 기능이 이제 리본에 안정적으로 표시됩니다. 설치되었지만 보이지 않던 추가 기능도 다시 표시됩니다.
changelog.ar: تظهر الآن الوظائف الإضافية المثبّتة بشكل موثوق في الشريط بعد إعادة التشغيل. وتظهر من جديد الوظائف الإضافية التي كانت مثبّتة لكنها غير مرئية.

complianceAudit.method: Checked all #include directives and linker inputs of PluginStore.vcxproj (Windows SDK incl. BCrypt/Crypt32 for SHA-256 and the ECDSA signature check, MFC/ATL, Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK only), the bundled UILayout and icon files (own work, icons drawn by client/res/make_icons.py) and the package contents. One third-party component: the Microsoft WebView2 SDK static loader (BSD-3-Clause), linked into PluginStore.zxt; its NOTICE lists only BSD-licensed .NET tooling that is not used. The bundled MSI is built with the WiX Toolset v3 (build tool; its standard WixUI dialog resources are part of the installer). No credentials, personal data or third-party trademarks in the package. The only network service is the configured Add-on Store server (HTTPS). The MSI also installs AddonStoreLink.exe (own code, no network access), which handles addonstore:// links by passing a validated package id to the client.

externalServices.name: Add-on Store server (configurable; default addon.power-pdf.de, Azure address ppdf-store.azurewebsites.net)
externalServices.data: Catalog, search and package downloads; sends the Power PDF UI language, the beta channel flag and, only when the user or IT entered one, the customer code of a delivery (X-Customer-Code header). The catalog is also read once in the background about 15 seconds after Power PDF starts and after the store window closes, to show the update badge (IT can switch this off with the policy UpdateBadge = 0). No personal data, no documents.

elevation.reason: Installing, updating and removing add-ons writes to Power PDF's Plug-Ins folder in Program Files: one PowerShell step runs elevated after the UAC prompt, only when the user installs, updates or removes an add-on (the self-update starts msiexec the same way).
